ApiError.x-kb-field-spec: code:int(501001-501071,required); statusText:string(required); messageKey:string(required); params:ErrorParams(required); message:string(required); errorType:string(required); retryable:string(required); severity:string(required); requestId:string(required); zodError?:JsonValue(optional)

TrainingErrorsQuery.x-kb-field-spec: taskId?:ObjectId; collectionId?:ObjectId; datasetId?:ObjectId; cursor?:string; limit:int=20(optional,default)(1-50); at least one scope

TrainingUpdateBody.x-kb-field-spec: dataId?:ObjectId; collectionId?:ObjectId; datasetId?:ObjectId; mode:enum(parse,chunk,qa,image,imageParse,required); at least one scope

SearchTestBody.x-kb-field-spec: datasetId:ObjectId(required); text?:string(≤4000); queryImageUrls?:string[]≤10; searchMode?:enum=embedding; limit?=10(1-50); similarity?=0(0-1); usingReRank?=false; embeddingWeight?=0.5; rerankWeight?=0.5; collectionFilterMatch?:string(≤2000); text or images required

DatasetSearchSubject.x-kb-field-spec: subjectRef:string(required); onBehalfOfTmbId?:ObjectId(optional); datasetIds:ObjectId[]≥1(required); collectionIds?:ObjectId[](optional); tagIds?:ObjectId[](optional); textQueries?:string[](optional); imageQueries?:ImageQuery[]≤10(optional); models:ModelSelection(required); searchMode:enum(embedding,fullTextRecall,mixedRecall,required); limit:int=10(optional,default); maxTokens:int=4000(optional,default); similarity:number=0(optional,default); weights?:SearchWeights(optional); budgets?:SearchBudgets(optional); versionPolicy?:SearchVersionPolicy(optional)

ImageQuery.x-kb-field-spec: key?:string≤512; url?:string≤2048; weight?:number(0-1); key or url required

Citation.x-kb-field-spec: dataId:string(required); chunkIndex:int(≥0,required); datasetId:string(required); collectionId:string(required); collectionName:string(required); sourceName:string(required); sourceType:enum(file,link,apiFile,externalFile,images,virtual,required); quoteText:string(required); imagePreviewUrls?:string[](optional); updateTime:string(required); scores:CitationScore[](required)

UploadPartForm.x-kb-field-spec: uploadId:string(required); partNumber:int(1-10000,required); chunk:binary(≤分片上限,required); checksum:string(required)

file.x-kb-constraints: csv 或 xlsx 或 jsonl,≤20MB,required

DatasetImportForm.x-kb-field-spec: file:binary(csv 或 xlsx 或 jsonl，≤20MB,required); datasetId:ObjectId(required); targetCollectionId?:ObjectId; mapping?:ImportMapping

ChunkPolicy.x-kb-field-spec: mode:enum(auto,paragraph,custom)=auto; chunkSize:int=1000(64-8000); minSize:int=100(1-4000); maxSize:int=8000(500-8000); overlapRatio:number=0.15(0-0.9); paragraphDeep:int=5(1-5); customRegs:string[]≤5; lengthUnit:enum(char,token)=token; forceSplit:bool=true; maxChunks:int=50000(1-50000)

QARequest.x-kb-field-spec: teamId:string(derived,required)(required); datasetId:ObjectId(required); collectionId:ObjectId(required); chunkText:string(required); qaTemplateId:string=qa.default(optional,default); qaTemplateVersion:int=1(optional,default); qaPrompt?:string(≤4000,optional); models:ModelSelection(required); limits:QALimits(optional,default)

CollectionCreateBackupForm.x-kb-field-spec: file:binary(csv 或 xlsx，≤20MB,required); datasetId:ObjectId(required); parentId?:ObjectId; mapping?:ImportMapping

DatasetSummary.x-kb-field-spec: datasetId:ObjectId(required); name:string(1-100,required); type:enum(knowledge,folder,external,api,feishu,yuque,dingtalk,required); parentId?:ObjectId|null; vectorModel:string(required); agentModel?:string|null; vlmModel?:string|null; chunkPolicy:ChunkPolicy(required); inheritPermission:bool(required); autoSync:bool(required); deleteTime?:Date|null; createTime:Date(required); updateTime:Date(required)

ScopeSelector.x-kb-field-spec: teamIds?:ObjectId[](optional); datasetIds?:ObjectId[](optional); collectionIds?:ObjectId[](optional); operationTypes?:enum(migrate,reconcile,report,cleanup)[](optional); 至少一个范围字段必填(required)

SearchStats.x-kb-field-spec: searchMode:string(required); usingReRank:bool(required); usingSimilarityFilter:bool(required); embeddingTokens:int(≥0,required); rerankInputTokens:int(≥0,required); degraded:DegradedInfo[](required); durationMs:int(≥0,required)
